segments.name: Business Unit Operations
segments.description: Contract manufacturing of electronic assemblies, medical devices, medical disposables and precision molded plastics for automotive, medical and industrial customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: All of our operating segments have similar long-term economic characteristics, and as such, have been aggregated into one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay on a contract basis for contract manufacturing services, engineering and supply chain support, and products built to their specifications.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer our services globally on a contract basis, and we manufacture products to our customers' specifications.
